data.name: Minesweeper

heroImage.alt: A classic minesweeper game with a partially revealed grid, numbered cells and hidden mines to uncover

data.fullDescription: Minesweeper — the classic. Mines are hidden across a grid of cells that can be closed, opened or flagged. Open a cell and it shows how many mines are around it, or a blank and a whole area opens up. Flag the cells you think are mined, and don't open a real one, because that's a loss.
